summary: Line runs along a median under the freeway overpass; no place to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Interchange of multi-lane roads and a freeway bridge; no cover or private ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Line follows a median strip between multi-lane carriageways; no pull-off and no way to stop clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Constant multi-lane and freeway traffic overhead.

sun_shade: Overpass shades the northern part; the rest is open.
